_comment: Perk adapter: Hydromancy - Water Magic Perk Tree 1.1 (Custom Skills tree). Its perks ask
Hydromancy.esp defines both, and its SkyPatcher magiceffect ini puts them on the water effects of
a fixed list of spell mods (Natura, Elemental Destruction Magic Redux, Phenderix, KittySpellPack01,
Water Atronach); water spells of any other mod get nothing.
Summons: the ini marks Natura's water atronachs, which Natura itself marks MagicSummonFamiliar, so
the summon line does not exclude MagicSummonFamiliar; the daedra tag keeps water animals out.
